description: This file defines the base class 'SugarView' which manages rendering views, including header, footer, errors, JavaScript, subpanels, and module menus for the SuiteCRM system. It also contains methods for handling session-based UI components, metadata, and tracking user interactions.

classes.name: SugarView
classes.description: Represents the base class for rendering views in SuiteCRM, handling layout, assets, errors, navigation, metadata, and user interaction tracking.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view with a bean and view object map, sets up module and action context.

methods.name: _initSmarty
methods.description: Sets up the Smarty template engine used for rendering views.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method orchestrating the view rendering process, including header, footer, errors, JavaScript, subpanels, and AJAX responses.

methods.name: displayErrors
methods.description: Outputs any errors collected during processing.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to perform actions before the main display logic.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to implement actual content rendering.

methods.name: _trackView
methods.description: Tracks user actions via the TrackerManager for analytics.

methods.name: displayHeader
methods.description: Generates and displays the page header including navigation, branding, and menu items.

methods.name: getModuleMenuHTML
methods.description: Stub method intended to return module-specific menu HTML.

methods.name: includeClassicFile
methods.description: Includes legacy or module-specific PHP files for classic views.

methods.name: _displayLoginJS
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript necessary for login view functionality.

methods.name: getJavascriptValidation
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for form validation based on date/time formats.

methods.name: _displayJavascript
methods.description: Outputs the necessary JavaScript assets and configuration variables.

methods.name: _getModLanguageJS
methods.description: Returns versioned script tag for module language strings.

methods.name: displayFooter
methods.description: Generates and outputs the footer section, including links, branding, and response time metrics.

methods.name: _displaySubPanels
methods.description: Displays subpanels related to the current bean and module.

methods.name: _buildModuleList
methods.description: Builds the list of modules accessible to the current user.

methods.name: _getOption
methods.description: Determines the value of a display option, with a default fallback.

methods.name: _track
methods.description: Saves user interaction data to the tracker system.

methods.name: _checkModule
methods.description: Validates that the specified module exists; terminates if not found.

methods.name: renderJavascript
methods.description: Delegates to output JavaScript assets and configuration.

methods.name: _calculateFooterMetrics
methods.description: Calculates response time and resource usage metrics for performance monitoring.

methods.name: _getStatistics
methods.description: Generates a report on page load time and resource usage.

methods.name: logMemoryStatistics
methods.description: Logs and reports memory usage during page rendering.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Loads and returns the module menu options, including create and list links, import options, and custom menus.

methods.name: getModuleMenuHTML
methods.description: Stub for generating module menu HTML.

methods.name: includeClassicFile
methods.description: Includes additional files for legacy or specific module views.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Determines the currently active module tab based on user preferences and request parameters.

methods.name: getModuleTitle
methods.description: Constructs breadcrumb navigation and title bar for the current module view.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Determines the appropriate metadata PHP file for the current view and module.

methods.name: getHelpText
methods.description: Returns HTML for a help link/button with an icon for creating new records in the module.

methods.name: getFavicon
methods.description: Retrieves the favicon image URL and type for the current module, defaulting to the sugar_icon.ico if specific favicon is missing.

methods.name: getCustomFilePathIfExists
methods.description: Wraps the call to get_custom_file_if_exists to get custom override paths for files.

methods.name: fetchTemplate
methods.description: Fetches template content using Smarty's fetch method.

methods.name: processRecentRecords
methods.description: Enhances recent tracker records with icons and shortened summaries for display.

methods.name: checkPostMaxSizeError
methods.description: Detects if a file upload exceeded post_max_size by verifying form submission errors and logs the issue.

methods.name: addDomJS
methods.description: Adds DOM-related JavaScript configurations to the view's settings, with warning if scope exists.

methods.name: getDomJS
methods.description: Returns the current settings array as a JSON-encoded string.

methods.name: hasDomJS
methods.description: Checks whether DOM JavaScript configurations have been set.

methods.name: mergeDeepArray
methods.description: Recursively merges multiple arrays into one, similar to Drupal's array_merge_deep.

methods.name: getNextResultsForDeepMerge
methods.description: Helper for deep merge, handling recursive merges of array values.

methods.name: getVardefsData
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions for a module's bean and returns as structured array.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Returns path of the PHP file containing metadata definitions for the current view and module.
